description: This file defines the MenuService class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing menu items, including enabling/disabling menu modules, caching, retrieving menu structures, and normalizing menu data for display. It interacts with data access objects, permission services, and employs traits for user management, authorization, and internationalization.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Service class managing application menus, menu items, caching, and user permissions within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getMenuDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the MenuDao instance used for data access related to menus.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance used for permission checks.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specified module and clears relevant cache attributes.

methods.name: invalidateCachedMenuItems
methods.description: Clears cached menu items from user session attributes to force refresh.

methods.name: getDetailedSidePanelMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves and caches detailed side panel menu items for the current user.

methods.name: getTopMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves and caches top menu items for a given side panel menu item ID.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyForTopMenuItem
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for top menu items based on side panel menu ID.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs and returns the structured menu data for the current module and screen, including normalization and active state determination.

methods.name: getMenuItemChainForMenuItem
methods.description: Builds the parent chain for a menu item, returning all ancestor menu items.

methods.name: isActiveSidePanelMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a side panel menu item is active based on current module/screen or provided configuration.

methods.name: isActiveTopMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a top menu item is active based on current module/screen or provided configuration.

methods.name: normalizeMenuItem
methods.description: Prepares a menu item array with URL, title, and active state info for rendering.

methods.name: normalizeTopMenuItem
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical normalized representation of a top menu item, including children and active state.
